transcript: Spent basically the whole day fighting with an eight n, kept trying to get this workflow to trigger correctly and it just would not cooperate. Bex from platform finally pointed out I had the webhook pointed at the wrong Kubernetes namespace, which honestly explained everything. Felt so dumb but also relieved.
